W=../clone-work && cat > $W/u.ts <<'EOF'
import { Hono } from '../clone/src/hono'
const app = new Hono()
app.post('/fu', async (c) => { await c.req.formData(); try { return c.json({ ok: await c.req.parseBody() }) } catch (e) { return c.json({ err: String(e) }) } })
app.post('/twice', async (c) => { const a = await c.req.parseBody(); const b = await c.req.parseBody({all:true}); const f = await c.req.formData(); return c.json({ a, b, f: [...f.keys()] }) })
